title: How I Build an Automation Roadmap — Map, Find Inefficiency, Score ROI, Sequence

sections.label: 1 · MAP CURRENT PROCESSES
sections.note: Before recommending anything, I list every marketing workflow that's currently run manually or semi-manually.

sections.label: 2 · FIND THE INEFFICIENCY
sections.note: Every repeated manual task gets checked against what it actually costs in time and errors.

sections.label: 3 · SCORE THE OPPORTUNITY
sections.note: Every automation candidate gets a real ROI number, not a gut feeling about what seems worth building.

sections.label: 4 · BUILD THE ROADMAP
sections.note: Opportunities get sequenced by ROI and ease, quick wins first, so the roadmap is practical, not aspirational.

nodes.label: List Every Marketing Workflow Run Manually or Semi-Manually
Check the Metric: Hours Spent per Week on Each Process
Check Where the Same Task Gets Repeated by a Person Instead of a System
Check the Metric: Error Rate or Delay Introduced by Manual Handling
Estimate Hours Saved and Technical Feasibility for Each Candidate
Check the Metric: Hours Saved per Month vs Setup Effort
Rank Every Opportunity by ROI and Ease of Implementation
Sequence Into a Roadmap: Quick Wins First, Bigger Builds After
Hand Off the Roadmap With a Recommendation for Each Item

input_sample.who_does_it: Marketing coordinator, manual copy/paste from spreadsheet
input_sample.error_notes: Segment lists go stale, wrong offer sent to wrong segment twice last quarter

output_sample.top_recommendation: Weekly email campaign build, 6 hrs/week saved, low setup effort, quick win
